values.headline: Millions in Yemen ‘a step away from starvation’
values.description: The crisis in Yemen, now in its seventh year of war, continues unabated, with thousands of people displaced and millions “a step away from starvation”, the UN Humanitarian Relief Coordinator said on Wednesday during a high-level side event on the margins of the 76th General Assembly.

values.headline: Government Restrictions on Religion Remain at Highest Levels in 2019, Social Hostilities Decline
values.description: Social hostilities involving religion, including violence and harassment against religious groups by private individuals and groups, declined in 2019, according to Pew Research Center’s 12th annual study of global restrictions on religion, which examines 198 countries and territories.
